title: Highlights in barcelona
text: Our tour guide, Matteo (Matt) was professional, courteous, informative and punctual.  His service was the best in our visit to Barcelona.  I would recommend him and would prefer him over the other guides we've had thus far.
author: Kuobin

title: Barcelona
text: Our tour guide, Isabel was super sweet and charming. She was very informative and knew a lot about the history of Barcelona.  Our driver, Roger went above and beyond making sure we were safe and well well hydrated, and even provided snack snacks for us. Both were amazing and made the long tour enjoyable. The only thing I would change are some of the stops and sites we were seeing. We didn’t feel like the stops were worth seeing compared to other places.
